rules.text: Returns with the original receipt are accepted within 90 days of purchase.
rules.quote: Within 90 days of purchase, we will gladly exchange the merchandise, give store credit, or issue a refund based on your original method of payment.

rules.text: Within 90 days of purchase with receipt, merchandise can be exchanged.
rules.quote: Within 90 days of purchase, we will gladly exchange the merchandise, give store credit, or issue a refund based on your original method of payment.

rules.text: Refunds are issued based on the original method of payment when returned with receipt within 90 days.
rules.quote: Within 90 days of purchase, we will gladly exchange the merchandise, give store credit, or issue a refund based on your original method of payment.

rules.text: There is a 10 calendar day wait on refunds for check purchases, or merchandise credit can be issued instead.
rules.quote: There will be a wait of 10 calendar days on check purchases, or merchandise credit can be issued.

rules.text: A valid ID is required for returns without the original store receipt.
Without the original receipt, merchandise can be exchanged or merchandise credit issued based on the lowest selling price in the last 60 days.
rules.quote: You may exchange the merchandise or be issued a merchandise credit based on the lowest selling price in the last 60 days.

rules.text: The store reserves the right to limit or refuse returns of certain products and non-receipted items.
rules.quote: We reserve the right to limit or refuse to accept the return of certain products and non-receipted items.
